title: Income-tax Act, 2025: TDS (s.392, s.393) and TCS (s.394) section codes, rates and thresholds

field_notes.code: Four-digit Protean section/collection code used in Forms 138, 140, 143, 144.
field_notes.table_serial: Section and Table serial as Protean prints it (verbatim from the code).
field_notes.rate_percent: Base rate in percent before surcharge and cess. null when the rate is split (see rate_split), slab-based, or not confirmed.
field_notes.threshold_inr: Rupee threshold; read with threshold_basis. null when none, slab-based, or not confirmed.
field_notes.old_1961_protean_code: Protean 1961 Act code for the same payment, only where packages/tax-engine/src/tds/dualActRecon.ts gives one.
field_notes.needs_verification: true when a value comes from a single secondary source, sources disagree, or a value is null for want of a source.

gaps: Codes 1007, 1010, 1025 and 1036 do not appear in the Form 140 code list (form140Codes.ts) or on tdsman; tdsman says 1007 and 1010 are not in the ITD reference document.
Higher rate for no PAN (s.397(2)) is not tabulated here; secondary sources give 20% as the usual floor.

Official ITD rate chart (incometaxindia.gov.in/w/tds-rates) and s.393 page returned HTTP 403 to the fetch tool on 2026-11-26; rates here rest on the code (which cites that chart, read 21 Nov 2026) and tdsman.
